name: a change with no observable behaviour gets no invented test
prompt: Patch track, one task: the export button label in src/reports/exportButton.tsx says "Exprot" and must say "Export". Nothing else changes. What test do you write first, and what do you return?

assertions.value: no test|without a test|nothing to test|no behaviour|no observable

why: The patch track exists for text, versions, formatting and dead code. Hunting for a failing test that cannot exist is where a one-word change used to lose its first ten minutes.
